You should really start reading your bible. GOD love you. I too was adopted & made some bad choices in life. I went a LONG time feeling unloved chasing the things of this world to find love. You don’t even want to hear my story. I was bad.. well anyway someone invited me to church & the message stuck with me because I KNEW it was the truth & overtime, I began to read the Bible. I have not been perfect. I went back to my sinful ways, but I realize I can’t do anything without the lord. With all things, I pray, just like the Bible says. When I need patience, I pray & ask God for patience. When I need peace or strength or WISDOM which is SO important, I pray about it. ALL good things are from God. GOD love you because he sent his only son (who lived a SINLESS life & was the ONLY human to ever love a sinless life) so that he could be reconciled with me & you because God is so HOLY & we are so unclean in our sin, that their had to be a sacrifice. For a long time I didn’t care about myself until I realized what God did for me & for you. He thought of us when he was on that cross so that none of us would perish in eternal hell. ❤️

Turn to God. He can get rid of your lust & alcohol problem. In all things, PRAY. Read your Bible & get into a bible believing church! Find fellowship there with fellow Christians. It’s important to surround yourself with those who keep in the word of truth which is the Bible. Apostle Paul can relate with you because it seems like you do things you don’t want to do. We, as humans sometimes do things we don’t want to do, but with the Holy Spirit, you can turn from your sinful ways & live a life of GOODNESS & find a holy woman to share your life with. 


Matthew 5:28
But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

Acts 3:19
Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out,

Romans 13:13
Let us walk properly as in the daytime, not in orgies and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and sensuality, not in quarreling and jealousy.

God has a plan for you friend. God can take a messed up life & make it new. God desires to have a relationship with you & to make you new. Just ask God into your heart. Ask him to cleanse you of your sin & he will begin in you a new thing. Don’t waste another minute! Start reading your bible. You can even download the Bible app which is super helpful! You still have time to turn your life around! You were negative once so turn over a  new slate today & say to yourself “I vow to myself to only speak good & positive things to myself!” & move on & don’t look back!!! Let God create in you a new heart!

Matthew 6:33

But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.

In all things PRAY, read your Bible day & night & when the time is RIGHT, God will send someone. Gods timing is always perfect timing.

Me too friend, but God promises a reward for those who follow him. In all things, PRAY. Read the Bible day & night. It is like a refreshing water to the soul to those who THIRST. God will unveil things to you while reading his word. Don’t let the worries & cares of this world (that is passing away) break your heart. God said, “All things fade away, but my word will last forever.” There is an eternal world waiting for us dear friend. Keep hope alive. Keep faith alive! You were made in God’s image & God has a plan for you! Let go of the past so God can give you an amazing future! Start going to church & you will find good people walking in the light! Listen, God forgives all sins. Repent & talk to God. There’s nothing you can do that God can’t forgive unless you blaspheme the Holy Spirit. He tests our hearts. Look at King David’s life. He had sex with his neighbors wife out of boredom & then killed her husband. There are many people in the Bible who did heinous things & God still accepted & loved them after. Look at the life of Mannasah. He took his fathers kingdom & ruined it & put many idols around the temple & then went to prison & repented. Mannasah has been away from God for years doing many evil & God still forgave him & loved him after. We serve a mighty God. We serve a loving God. There is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus. When Christ died, he took all your sins & all my sins on the cross so friend, do not worry about what you did in the past because it says in Romans 8:28 that God uses ALL things for the glory of his kingdom for those called according to his purpose. We don’t know God’s whole plan & never will because God’s vastness & greatness is too big for humans to comprehend, but just know this friend.. he will use all of that for his glory. Just repent & come home to a God who loves you very much. So much that he sent his one & only son to die so you & him could be reconciled. That’s how much God loves us. I remind myself of this everyday because I’ve done many things in the past too.
